stats table and QC plots

```{r}

dir <- getwd()
rpc <- fread(paste0(dir, "/sbrna_ss3x.readspercell.txt"))

rpc <- rpc[RG != "bad",]
rpc <- dcast(rpc, RG~type, fill = 0, value.var = "N")
rpc[,total_reads_per_cell := as.numeric(Ambiguity+Exon+Intergenic+Intron+Unmapped+User)][
        ,percent_exonintron := as.numeric((Exon+Intron)/total_reads_per_cell)]

# add meta data

mdat <- fread(paste0(dir, "/sbrna_ss3x_meta.csv"))
rpc_meta <- merge(rpc, mdat, by.x = "RG", by.y = "XC_NovaSeq")

# human/mouse reads

rds <- readRDS(paste0(dir, "/sbrna_ss3x.dgecounts.tsofiltered.rds"))
readexall <- as.matrix(rds$readcount$exon$all)
# write.table(readexall, gzfile("sbrna_ss3x.exon_read_counts.mtx.gz"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE, col.names = NA)

complexity <- data.table(
  XC_NovaSeq = colnames(readexall),
  nGenes = colSums(readexall > 0),
  hs_reads = colSums(readexall[grep("ENSG",row.names(readexall)),]),
  mm_reads = colSums(readexall[grep("ENSMUS",row.names(readexall)),]),
  fract_hs_reads = colSums(readexall[grep("ENSG",row.names(readexall)),])/colSums(readexall),
  fract_mm_reads = colSums(readexall[grep("ENSMUS",row.names(readexall)),])/colSums(readexall)       
)

complexity[fract_hs_reads < 0.75 & fract_mm_reads < 0.75, species := "mixed"][
      fract_hs_reads >= 0.75 , species := "Human"][
      fract_mm_reads >= 0.75 , species := "Mouse"]

rpc_meta_hsmm <- merge(rpc_meta, complexity, by.x = "RG", by.y = "XC_NovaSeq")

# convert ENSEMBL-IDs to gene names

genenames <- fread(paste0(dir, "/sbrna_ss3x.gene_names.txt"))
genenames <- rbind(genenames,
                   data.table(
                     gene_id = row.names(readexall)[which(!row.names(readexall) %in% genenames$gene_id)],
                     gene_name = row.names(readexall)[which(!row.names(readexall) %in% genenames$gene_id)]
                   ))
genenames_match <- genenames[match(row.names(readexall),gene_id)]
genenames_match[duplicated(gene_name), gene_name:= paste0(gene_name,sample(genenames_match[duplicated(gene_name),.N], replace = F))]
row.names(readexall) <- genenames_match$gene_name
rownames(readexall) <- sub("^molspike", "sbRNA", rownames(readexall))

# sbRNA and mitochondrial reads and fractions

mito_sbrna <- data.table( XC_NovaSeq = colnames(readexall),
                    mitoFrac = colSums(readexall[grep("^mt-|^MT-", row.names(readexall)),])/colSums(readexall),
                    sbrnaFrac = colSums(readexall[grep("^sbRNA", row.names(readexall)),])/colSums(readexall))


rpc_meta_hsmm_mito_sbrna <- merge(rpc_meta_hsmm, mito_sbrna, by.x = "RG", by.y = "XC_NovaSeq")

ggplot(rpc_meta_hsmm_mito_sbrna, aes(total_reads_per_cell, percent_exonintron*100)) +
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(show.legend = FALSE) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans="log10") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  xlab("Number of reads") +
  ylab("Percent exon+intron reads") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1e04, linetype = "dashed") +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 60, linetype = "dashed")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/QC_nreads_percentexonintron_scatterplot.pdf")

ggplot(rpc_meta_hsmm_mito_sbrna, aes(total_reads_per_cell, mitoFrac*100)) +
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(show.legend = FALSE) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans="log10") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  xlab("Number of reads") +
  ylab("Percent mt reads") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1e04, linetype = "dashed") +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/QC_nreads_percentmito_scatterplot.pdf")

ggplot(rpc_meta_hsmm_mito_sbrna, aes(total_reads_per_cell, sbrnaFrac*100)) +
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(show.legend = FALSE) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans="log10") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  xlab("Number of reads") +
  ylab("Percent sbRNA reads") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1e04, linetype = "dashed")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/QC_nreads_percentsbrna_scatterplot.pdf")

ggplot(rpc_meta_hsmm_mito_sbrna, aes(total_reads_per_cell, nGenes)) +
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans="log10") +
  scale_y_continuous(trans="log10") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  xlab("Number of reads") +
  ylab("Number of genes") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1e04, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 800, linetype = "dashed")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/QC_nreads_ngenes_scatterplot.pdf")

filtered_bcs <- rpc_meta_hsmm_mito_sbrna[total_reads_per_cell > 1e04 & percent_exonintron > 0.60 & mitoFrac < 0.20 & nGenes > 800, RG]

ggplot(rpc_meta_hsmm_mito_sbrna, aes(fill = species, x = hs_reads, y = mm_reads)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.33, shape = 21) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  xlab("Reads aligned to Human") + 
  ylab("Reads aligned to Mouse")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/scatterplot_mousehumanmixed.pdf")

```

Seurat clustering and UMAP

```{r}

mdat <- as.data.frame(mdat, row.names = mdat$XC_NovaSeq)
rownames(mdat) <- mdat$XC_NovaSeq
mdat$XC_NovaSeq <- NULL

set.seed(42)

umiexall <- as.matrix(rds$umicount$exon$all)
# write.table(umiexall, gzfile("sbrna_ss3x.exon_umi_counts.mtx.gz"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE, col.names = NA)

genenames <- rbind(genenames,
                   data.table(
                     gene_id = row.names(umiexall)[which(!row.names(umiexall) %in% genenames$gene_id)],
                     gene_name = row.names(umiexall)[which(!row.names(umiexall) %in% genenames$gene_id)]
                   ))
genenames_match <- genenames[match(row.names(umiexall),gene_id)]
genenames_match[duplicated(gene_name), gene_name:= paste0(gene_name,sample(genenames_match[duplicated(gene_name),.N], replace = F))]
row.names(umiexall) <- genenames_match$gene_name
rownames(umiexall) <- sub("^molspike", "sbRNA", rownames(umiexall))


seuob <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(counts = umiexall[,filtered_bcs], project = "sbRNA_ss3x", meta.data = mdat)

FeatureScatter(seuob, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
seuob <- SCTransform(seuob)
seuob <- RunPCA(seuob, seed.use = 42)
ElbowPlot(seuob, ndims = 40)
seuob <- FindNeighbors(seuob, dims = 1:20)
seuob <- FindClusters(seuob, random.seed = 42)
seuob <- RunUMAP(seuob, dims = 1:20, seed.use = 42)
DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_seurat_clusters_umis.pdf")

```

Comparison storage temperature

```{r}

DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap", group.by = "temperature", split.by = "protocol", cols = c("min20C" = "#AFD9FF", "4C" = "#3D7FB8"))

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_temperature_protocol.pdf")

# extract sbRNA counts from countmat

sbrna_counts <- FetchData(
  object = seuob,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "counts",
  vars = c("sbRNA-2", "sbRNA-5","sbRNA-9", "sbRNA-11", "temperature", "protocol")
)
setDT(sbrna_counts, keep.rownames = "RG")

sbrna_long <- melt(sbrna_counts, id.vars = c("RG","temperature", "protocol"), measure.vars = c("sbRNA-2", "sbRNA-5","sbRNA-9", "sbRNA-11"), variable.name = "sbRNA", value.name = "counts")

sbrna_long[,counts_log := log10(counts + 1)]
sbrna_long[, c("temperature", "protocol") := lapply(.SD, as.factor), .SDcols = c("temperature", "protocol")]

fit <- lmer(
  counts_log ~ temperature * protocol + (1 | sbRNA),
  data = sbrna_long
)

summary(fit)

# get p values

s <- summary(fit)
coefs <- as.data.table(s$coefficients, keep.rownames = T)
y_max <- max(sbrna_long$counts_log)

pvals <- data.frame(
  protocol = c("mixWash", "washMix"),
  x = 1.3,
  y = y_max + 0.3,
  label = c(paste0("p = ", round(coefs[2,6],3), " (LMM)"), paste0("p = ", round(coefs[4,6],3), " (LMM)"))
)

# plot by protocol

ggplot(sbrna_long, aes(x = sbRNA, y = counts_log, fill = temperature)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = temperature), alpha = 0.4, size = 1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(data = pvals, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4) +
  facet_wrap(~ protocol) +
  labs(
    x = "sbRNA",
    y = "log10(sbRNA count + 1)",
    fill = "Temperature",
    color = "Temperature",
    title = "sbRNA recovery per temperature and protocol"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("min20C" = "#A6D5FF", "4C" = "#2C7FB8")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("min20C" = "#A6D5FF", "4C" = "#2C7FB8")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/boxplots_sbRNArecovery_bytemperature_byprotocol_comparison.pdf")
```

souporcell assignment

```{r}

soup <- fread(paste0(dir,"/sbrna_ss3x.clusters.tsv"))

soup_used <- soup[barcode %in% filtered_bcs]
soup_used <- soup_used[assignment %in% c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)]
soup_used$assignment <- paste0("donor",soup_used$assignment)

soup_sum <- soup_used[, .(count = .N), .(assignment)]
snp_assignments <- soup_used[!(assignment %in% c("doublet", "unassigned")), c("barcode", "assignment")]
setnames(snp_assignments,"assignment", "assignment_souporcell")

snp_assignments <- as.data.frame(snp_assignments)
rownames(snp_assignments) <- snp_assignments$barcode
snp_assignments$barcode <- NULL
seuob <- AddMetaData(seuob, metadata = snp_assignments)

DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap", group.by = "assignment_souporcell")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_snp.pdf")

# merge Seurat clusters based on souporcell info

seuob$merged_clusters <- as.character(seuob$seurat_clusters)
seuob$merged_clusters[seuob$merged_clusters == "1"] <- "0"
seuob$merged_clusters[seuob$merged_clusters == "4"] <- "3"
ordered_clusters <- names(sort(table(seuob$merged_clusters), decreasing = TRUE))
seuob$merged_clusters <- match(as.character(seuob$merged_clusters), ordered_clusters) - 1
seuob$merged_clusters_label <- paste0("c", seuob$merged_clusters)

DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap", group.by = "merged_clusters_label", label = T, repel = TRUE)

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_merged_clusters.pdf")

p <- DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap", group.by = "assignment_souporcell",label = F)

p +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = data.frame(
      Embeddings(seuob, "umap"),
      cluster = seuob$merged_clusters
    ) |>
      dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        UMAP_1 = median(umap_1),
        UMAP_2 = median(umap_2)
      ),
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = paste0("c", cluster)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    color = "#8F8F8F",
    fontface = "bold",
    force = 5,
    point.padding = 2
    
  )

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_souporcell_withclusters_merged.pdf")

# bar plot souporcell assignment by merged Seurat cluster

soc <- copy(seuob@meta.data)
setDT(soc, keep.rownames = T)
soc_counts <- soc[, .(n_cells_label = .N), by = c("merged_clusters_label", "assignment_souporcell")]
soc_totals <- soc[, .(n_cells_group = .N), by = "merged_clusters_label"]

soc_plot <- merge(soc_counts, soc_totals, by = "merged_clusters_label")
soc_plot[, fraction := n_cells_label / n_cells_group]

ggplot(soc_plot, aes(x = merged_clusters_label, y = fraction * 100, fill = assignment_souporcell)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    labs(x = "Merged clusters", y = "Percentage") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    coord_flip()

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/bars_mergedclusters_snp.pdf")
```

identify cell lines by mapping pseudobulk to human reference RNA-seq data

```{r}

# read DepMap info

ccle <- fread(paste0(dir,"/resources/OmicsExpressionTPMLogp1HumanProteinCodingGenes.csv"))
ccle <- ccle[IsDefaultEntryForModel == "Yes"]
gene_cols <- names(ccle)[!(names(ccle) %in% c(
  "ProfileID",
  "ModelID",
  "V1",
  "SequencingID",
  "ModelConditionID",
  "IsDefaultEntryForModel",
  "IsDefaultEntryForMC"
))]

clean_names <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)", "", gene_cols)
anyDuplicated(clean_names) # no duplicated gene names
names(ccle)[names(ccle) %in% gene_cols] <- clean_names
expr <- as.data.frame(ccle)
rownames(expr) <- expr$ModelID

expr <- expr[ ,
    !(names(expr) %in%
      c("V1",
        "SequencingID",
        "ModelID",
        "ModelConditionID",
        "IsDefaultEntryForModel",
        "IsDefaultEntryForMC"))
]

expr <- t(as.matrix(expr))

# correlate pseudobulk per cluster with reference RNA-seq data for human cell lines

# add species info to Seurat and select human cells

add_meta <- as.data.frame(rpc_meta_hsmm_mito_sbrna)
rownames(add_meta) <- add_meta$RG
add_meta$RG <- NULL
seuob <- AddMetaData(seuob, metadata = add_meta)

seurat_human <- subset(seuob, subset = species == "Human")
human_cluster_ids <- unique(seurat_human$merged_clusters_label)

# make pseudobulk per cluster

pb <- AggregateExpression(
    seurat_human,
    assays = "RNA",
    group.by = "merged_clusters_label",
    return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA

# normalize pseudobulk to compare to normalized ccle (not accounting for gene length here)

pb_cpm <- t(t(pb) / colSums(pb) * 1e6)
pb_log <- log2(pb_cpm + 1)

cor_to_ccle <- function(cluster_vec, expr_matrix) {

    common <- intersect(names(cluster_vec), rownames(expr_matrix))

    cluster_vec <- cluster_vec[common]
    expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[common, , drop = FALSE]

    cors <- apply(expr_matrix, 2, function(x)cor(cluster_vec, x, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
    sort(cors, decreasing = TRUE)
}

# add model info

models <- fread(paste0(dir, "/resources/Model.csv"))

results_list <- list()

for (cl in colnames(pb_log)) {

    message("Processing cluster: ", cl)

    cors <- cor_to_ccle(pb_log[, cl], expr)

    hits <- data.frame(
        ModelID = names(cors),
        correlation = as.numeric(cors)
    )

    hits <- merge(hits, models[, .(ModelID, CellLineName, OncotreeLineage, OncotreePrimaryDisease)], by = "ModelID", all.x = TRUE)
    hits <- hits[order(-hits$correlation), ]
    hits$cluster <- cl
    results_list[[cl]] <- hits
}

results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# visualize highest scoring candidates

expected <- c("THP-1", "JURKAT", "MDA-MB-231", "MCF-7")
setDT(results, keep.rownames = T)

plot_dt <- results[CellLineName %in% expected, .(cluster, CellLineName, correlation)]

ggplot(plot_dt,aes(CellLineName, factor(cluster), fill = correlation)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    labs(
        x = "Expected cell line",
        y = "Merged clusters",
        fill = "Spearman\ncorrelation"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/heatmap_celllines.pdf")

plot_dt[, cluster := as.integer(sub("^c", "", cluster))]

# select top correlating cell line per cluster

best_hits <- plot_dt[order(plot_dt, -correlation), .SD[1], by = cluster]

seuob$cellline <- best_hits$CellLineName[match(as.character(seuob$merged_clusters_label), as.character(paste0("c", best_hits$cluster)))]
seuob$cellline[seuob$cellline == "JURKAT"] <- "Jurkat"

# annotate mouse cluster as 4T1

seuob$cellline[seuob$seurat_clusters == unique(seuob@meta.data[is.na(seuob@meta.data$cellline),"seurat_clusters"])] <- "4T1"

p2 <- DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cellline")

p2 +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = data.frame(
      Embeddings(seuob, "umap"),
      cluster = seuob$merged_clusters
    ) |>
      dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        UMAP_1 = median(umap_1),
        UMAP_2 = median(umap_2)
      ),
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = paste0("c", cluster)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    color = "#8F8F8F",
    fontface = "bold",
    force = 5,
    point.padding = 2
    
  )

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_celllines.pdf")

```

use Seurat's HTO demux to identify sbRNA identities

```{r}

# extract sbRNA counts from countmat

rna_counts <- LayerData(object = seuob, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
sbrna_counts <- rna_counts[c("sbRNA-2", "sbRNA-5","sbRNA-9", "sbRNA-11"), , drop = FALSE]

# add as own assay

seuob[["HTO"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = sbrna_counts)
seuob <- NormalizeData(seuob, assay="HTO", normalization.method="CLR", margin=2)
seuob <- HTODemux(seuob, assay="HTO", positive.quantile=0.999)

# set colors

my_colors <- c(
  "sbRNA-2" = "#7CAE00",
  "sbRNA-5" = "#00BFC4",
  "sbRNA-9" = "#C77CFF",
  "sbRNA-11" = "#F8766D",
  "Doublet" = "#7F7F7F",
  "Negative" = "#D3D3D3"
)

seuob$hash.ID <- factor(seuob$hash.ID,levels = c("sbRNA-2", "sbRNA-5", "sbRNA-9", "sbRNA-11", "Doublet", "Negative"))

DimPlot(seuob, group.by="hash.ID", split.by="protocol", cols = my_colors, pt.size=.5)

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_washMix_sbRNA_byprotocol.pdf")

# UMAP per protocol

seuob_protocols <- SplitObject(seuob, split.by = "protocol")

DimPlot(seuob_protocols$washMix, reduction = "umap", group.by = "hash.ID", cols = my_colors) + ggtitle("washMix")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_washMix_hashID.pdf")

DimPlot(seuob_protocols$mixWash, reduction = "umap", group.by = "hash.ID", cols = my_colors) + ggtitle("mixWash")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_mixWash_hashID.pdf")

```

sbRNA assignment stacked bar plots

```{r}

# sbRNA assignment stats

md <- copy(seuob@meta.data)
setDT(md, keep.rownames = T)

dt_cellline_counts <- md[, .(n_cells_cellline = .N), by = c("cellline", "protocol")]
md[dt_cellline_counts, n_cells_cellline := i.n_cells_cellline, on = c("cellline", "protocol")]

dt_cellline_counts <- md[, .(n_cells_sbRNA = .N), by = c("cellline", "hash.ID", "protocol")]
md[dt_cellline_counts, n_cells_sbRNA := i.n_cells_sbRNA, on = c("cellline", "hash.ID", "protocol")]
md[,fraction_sbRNA := n_cells_sbRNA/n_cells_cellline]

md_plottable <- unique(md[,c("cellline", "hash.ID", "fraction_sbRNA", "protocol")])

ggplot(md_plottable, aes(x = cellline, y = fraction_sbRNA*100, fill = hash.ID)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(x = "cell line", y = "percentage") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors)

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/stackedBarplot_sbRNAs_mixWash_cellline.pdf")

ggplot(md_plottable[protocol == "washMix"], aes(x = cellline, y = fraction_sbRNA*100, fill = hash.ID)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(x = "cell line", y = "percentage") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors)

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/stackedBarplot_sbRNAs_washMix_cellline.pdf")

ggplot(md_plottable, aes(x = cellline, y = fraction_sbRNA*100, fill = hash.ID)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(x = "cell line", y = "percentage") +
  facet_wrap(~ protocol) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors)

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/stackedBarplot_sbRNAs_washMix_cellline_bothprotocols.pdf")

# more stats

# add expected sbRNA
exp <- data.table(
  cellline = c("THP-1", "4T1", "MDA-MB-231", "Jurkat", "MCF-7"),  
  exp_sbRNA = c("sbRNA-2", "Negative", "sbRNA-11", "sbRNA-5", "sbRNA-9")
  )

md_merge <- merge(md, exp, by = "cellline")

# assign if wrong/correct/doublet/unassigned

# cases: exp_sbRNA is Negative then
#           if hash.ID is Negative = correct;
#           if hash.ID is not Negative = wrong;
#        exp_sbRNA is not Negative then
#           if hash.ID is Negative = unassigned;
#           if hash.ID is the same = correct;
#           if hash.ID is Doublet = doublet;
#           if hash.ID is another sbRNA = wrong;


md_merge[, assignment := ifelse(
  exp_sbRNA == "Negative",                 # if expected sbRNA is Negative:
    ifelse(
      hash.ID == "Negative",               # and assigned sbRNA is Negative
      "correct",                           # then mark as correct
      "wrong"                              # otherwise mark as wrong
    ),
  ifelse(                                  # if expected sbRNA is NOT Negative:
    hash.ID == "Negative",                 # if assigned sbRNA is Negative
    "unassigned",                          # then mark as unassigned
    ifelse(
      hash.ID == exp_sbRNA,                # otherwise if assigned sbRNA is same as expected
      "correct",                           # then mark as correct
      ifelse(
        hash.ID == "Doublet",              # otherwise if assigned sbRNA is Doublet
        "doublet",                         # then mark as doublet
        "wrong")                           # otherwise (if assigned sbRNA is another sbRNA than expected) mark as wrong
      )
    ))]

stats_assignment <- md_merge[,
  .(n_cells_cellline = unique(n_cells_cellline),
    n_correct = sum(assignment == "correct"),
    frac_correct = sum(assignment == "correct") / unique(n_cells_cellline),
    n_wrong = sum(assignment == "wrong"),
    frac_wrong = sum(assignment == "wrong") / unique(n_cells_cellline),
    n_doublet = sum(assignment == "doublet"),
    frac_doublet = sum(assignment == "doublet")/ unique(n_cells_cellline),
    n_unassigned = sum(assignment == "unassigned"),
    frac_unassigned = sum(assignment == "unassigned")/ unique(n_cells_cellline),
    n_singlet = sum(!hash.ID %in% c("Doublet", "Negative"))
  ),
  by = c("cellline","protocol")]

stats_long <- melt(stats_assignment, id.vars = c("cellline", "protocol", "n_cells_cellline"),
  measure.vars = c("frac_correct", "frac_wrong", "frac_unassigned", "frac_doublet"),
  variable.name = "status",
  value.name = "fraction")

colors <- c(
  "frac_correct"    = "#009E73",
  "frac_wrong"      = "#D55E00",
  "frac_doublet"    = "#7F7F7F",
  "frac_unassigned" = "#D9D9D9"
)

stats_long$status <- factor(stats_long$status, levels = c("frac_unassigned", "frac_doublet", "frac_wrong", "frac_correct"))

ggplot(stats_long, aes(x = cellline, y = fraction*100, fill = status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(x = "cell line", y = "percentage") +
  facet_wrap(~ protocol) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# washMix fractions correctly assigned cells by cell line

stats_assignment[protocol == "washMix" & cellline == "Jurkat", frac_correct] # 0.9692308
stats_assignment[protocol == "washMix" & cellline == "MCF-7", frac_correct] # 0.8888889
stats_assignment[protocol == "washMix" & cellline == "MDA-MB-231", frac_correct] # 1
stats_assignment[protocol == "washMix" & cellline == "THP-1", frac_correct] # 0.859375
stats_assignment[protocol == "washMix" & cellline == "4T1", frac_correct] # 1

# HTO margin distribution

df <- FetchData(
    subset(seuob, subset = protocol == "washMix"),
    vars = c("HTO_margin", "hash.ID"))

ggplot(df,aes(x = HTO_margin, y = hash.ID, height = after_stat(density), fill = hash.ID, colour = hash.ID)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 2, rel_min_height = 0.001, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = my_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "HTO_margin",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Distribution HTO_margin",
    fill = "hash.ID",
    colour = "hash.ID"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev)

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/density_HTOmargin_washMix.pdf")

# mean accuracy washmix protocol across labeled cell lines

mean(stats_assignment[cellline != "4T1" & protocol == "washMix", frac_correct]) # 0.9293737
```

```{r}
# stacked bar plots with all sbRNA counts, per cellline

sbrna_long[, total_sbRNA_counts := sum(counts), by = RG]
sbrna_long[, max_sbRNA := sbRNA[which.max(counts)], by = RG]
sbrna_long[, sbRNA_fraction := counts / total_sbRNA_counts]

# add cell line info

sbrna_md <- merge(sbrna_long, md, by.x = "RG", by.y = "rn")
sbrna_md_filtered <- sbrna_md[total_sbRNA_counts > 0,]

# set order of sbRNA stacking

rna_order <- sbrna_md_filtered[, .(mean_fraction = mean(sbRNA_fraction, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(cellline, sbRNA)]
rna_order[, stack_rank := frank(-mean_fraction, ties.method = "first"), by = cellline]
sbrna_md_filtered[rna_order, stack_rank := i.stack_rank, on = .(cellline, sbRNA)]

cell_order <- dcast(sbrna_md_filtered,
  cellline + RG ~ stack_rank,
  value.var = "sbRNA_fraction",
  fill = 0
)

rank_cols <- setdiff(names(cell_order), c("cellline", "RG"))
rank_cols <- rank_cols[order(as.integer(rank_cols))]

setorderv(cell_order,
  cols = c("cellline", rank_cols),
  order = c(1L, rep(-1L, length(rank_cols)))
)

cell_order[, CellOrder := seq_len(.N), by = cellline]

sbrna_md_filtered[cell_order,
     CellOrder := i.CellOrder,
     on = .(cellline, RG)]

ggplot(sbrna_md_filtered, aes(x = CellOrder, y = sbRNA_fraction*100, fill = sbRNA, order = sbRNA_fraction, group = interaction(cellline, RG, stack_rank))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(x = "cells", y = "Percent") +
  facet_wrap(~cellline, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
```
